🦊 Kidsy Privacy Policy

Last updated November 13, 2026 · Applies to the Kidsy app on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.

The short version

Kidsy does not collect, store or share any personal information. There are no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

What stays on the device

The child's display name, chosen avatar, grade, scores, stickers and settings are saved only on the device, in the app's own storage. They are never sent to us. Deleting the app deletes them. Parents can also reset them in Me → Rewards → Reset.

Microphone

When a child taps the microphone to say an answer, the device's built-in speech recognition (provided by Apple or Google as part of the operating system) turns the speech into text so Kidsy can check it. Kidsy does not record or keep any audio. The microphone is only used after the child taps the button, and permission can be turned off at any time in the device settings.

Optional online features

A few features need the internet. They send only the word or sentence being looked up, never anything about the child:

  • Word meanings and translations: the word is sent to a public dictionary service (dictionaryapi.dev) or translation service (mymemory.translated.net).
  • Online read-aloud voices (off by default): the sentence to be read is sent to a text-to-speech service. The device's own voice is used otherwise.
  • Fonts and some pictures are loaded from Google Fonts and GitHub.

Everything else in Kidsy works offline.

Children

Kidsy is made for children aged 5 to 12. Because we collect no personal information, there is nothing for us to share, sell or disclose. Kidsy contains no advertising, no in-app purchases and no links to social media.

Questions

See the Kidsy support page. If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.
